blockdesc-press: A hand screw fly press. Put plate in through the body's window, then swing the fly to punch washers out of it, one a stroke.
blockdesc-machine-drill-*: A drilling machine on the mechanical shaft line. Put a plate on the table through the body's window, fit a drill bit and throw the lever; it drills while the shaft turns.
washerpunch:press-nojob: The press has no job for {0}.
